answer: A concrete sybil defense is hardware-diverse capacity proof: each identity must serve the network with real compute whose fingerprint (CPU vendor, memory speed) is checked, so one operator cannot clone cheap identities on one box. Reward weight scales with provable capacity, like weighing the true output of a forge rather than counting furnace names. Probes run from observation posts placed apart, on a knoll or rooftop site, so one household cannot fake many locations. copper windings and solder details make hardware claims auditable, capacity never trusted above its verified ceiling.
